rationale:
Issue #56 reports that IkigaJSONDecoder throws 'Unexpected End of File' when decoding a bare root-level `null` into an optional, while Foundation's JSONDecoder succeeds. The minimized production patch touches only Sources/_JSONCore/Parser/JSONParser+Parsing.swift and consists of three one-line boundary corrections in the literal-scanning switch: `count > 5` -> `count >= 5` (false), `count > 4` -> `count >= 4` (true), `count > 4` -> `count >= 4` (null). The literal byte lengths (false=5, true/null=4) match the guards, so the change is an off-by-one boundary fix, not a behavior extension; the `true`/`false` branches are the identical defect in adjacent cases of the same switch, so they belong to the same root cause rather than being an unrelated refactor. No formatting, documentation, configuration, or dependency changes appear (other_file_count=0; production_files lists a single file). The trigger `testRootLevelPrimitiveDecoding` is the unmodified upstream test from the same fixing commit and uses only the pre-existing public surface `IkigaJSONDecoder().decode(_:from:)` with in-memory Data, so no fix-only symbol is referenced and it compiles on both revisions. Machine-generated strict evidence passes on both the original and post-minimization runs: build.both_versions PASS, selectors.present_and_unique (1 valid, unique), trigger.buggy_differential reproduced on Tests/IkigaJSONTests/JSONTests.swift::testRootLevelPrimitiveDecoding, trigger.fixed_clean PASS, trigger.deterministic with 3 repetitions across a complete 32-run matrix, full_suite.buggy_reproduces_only_triggers PASS, full_suite.fixed_all_green PASS, failed_checks empty. Traceability is fix_commit_to_merged_pr_to_issue via merged PR #57 ('Fixes #56'), and verified_fix_issue_numbers=[56] matches the allowed root cause id. active_same_project_root_causes is empty, so this root cause is not a duplicate.
